content:
id: drive_create_folder_probe
description: |
  WRITE — create Drive folder named exactly "COMSTAR harness probe".
  Prefer Desktop scopes; TV drive.file may still allow app-created folders.
  Pair with drive_trash_probe for cleanup.
expected_output: >
  Spoken confirmation the folder was created, or scope / connect-Google message.
assertions:
  - type: min_chars
    value: 20
  - type: forbids_regex
    pattern: '(?i)(https?://|```)'
fixtures:
  inject_transcript: "Create a Google Drive folder named COMSTAR harness probe."
